settings.privacy_body_1: API llavekunayki navegadornikipi (localStorage) waqaychasqa kaspa IA API-man kachakun — mana suk serveraman. Munasqaykipi puchukachiy llaveta orqhospa waqaychay, utaq navegadornikipi sitio datata puchukachiy.
settings.privacy_body_2: Kay aplicación soqtantan waqaychan localStorage-pi: ñiqin munay, simi munay, plataforma filtro (Web/Masinchik), kawsaq maskay, IA aktivo, API llavekuna. Mana suk data waqaychasqa utaq kachakusqa.

settings.reduced_motion_note: Tikraq huyñuy iskayniykiman churasqa kaspa cheqaqta riqsiniku. Konfeti hina animacionkunaqa brincakusqa kanqam sistema accesibilidad ruwaykuykunapi tikrankikama.

about.what_body: Huk accesibilidad auditoria qillqaq yanapaق. WCAG-wan tupaq defectos qillqasqa mask'ay, tawqay chaynawan tupaqta, allinchaspa, ñuqap informe-ta churay.
about.what_wcag: Coverage extends up to WCAG 2.2 (Level A and AA) across both web and native app contexts.
about.step_1_body: Rimayki imatam rikusqaykita — componente suti, elemento tipo, manachayqa ñawpaq rimayta.
about.step_2_body: Defecto maskhay allinwan tupaqta akllay. Tupaqman hina churasqa.
about.step_3_body: Llaqta sutita churay (ej. "Llapan:") IA Refine ñanpi allinchay.
about.step_4_body: Qillqasqata remediation ñankunawan spreadsheet manachayqa informe-man churay.
about.feature_ai_body: API llave, IA proveedor — mana server-pi waqaychasqa.
about.feature_a11y_body: WCAG 2.2: focus, live regions, keyboard, reduced motion, high-contrast.
about.coming_auth: Google manachayqa GitHub sign in devices.
settings.confirm_reset_all_body: API llaves chaynawan llapan configuración. Mana kutichipaykunachu.

results.vote_hint: Vote results up or down — higher-rated matches appear first. Star a result to always pin it to the top.

settings.voting_on: Vote controls are visible on each result.
about.step_5_body: Use the up/down arrows on each result to tune how results are ranked. Star a result to always pin it first. Archive entries you never want to see again.
